To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the TMOKE is enhanced by the optical excitation in a bilayer composed of YIG and gold with grating.
we propose a new method of optical excitations of magnetization in a magnetoplasmonic system via frequency comb, which is shown to result in the enhancement of the transverse Kerr effect.
we propose a new method of optical excitation of spin waves in magnetoplasmonics systems via frequency comb, and that this excitation is resonant with spin wave modes in the system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of novel magnetoplasmonic devices for the optical excitation and manipulation of magnetization dynamics in magnetic thin films and nanostructures.
the optical excitation and control of magnetization dynamics in magnetoplasmonics.
the optical manipulation of spin waves in magnetically ordered solids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the frequency comb with parameters chosen in resonant to spin waves in YIG, can be used for the resonant spin wave exciation in magnetoplasmonics systems.
the optical excitation via frequency comb is a powerful tool for the resonant control of the magnetization dynamics in bilayer systems.

the frequency comb is a powerful tool to study the magnetization dynamics of ferromagnets, and the results obtained here are important for the understanding of the magnetization dynamics in ferromagnetic materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the resonant excitation of spin waves in YIG by the frequency comb leads to an increase of the TMOKE by a factor of 2-4 in comparison with the case when the frequency comb was detuned from the spin-wave resonance.
the proposed method of optical excitation of spin waves can be considered as a promising alternative for the existing ones, which are based on microwave radiation.
the proposed method can be applied in the field of magnonics and spintronics, as well as in the field of optical manipulation of magnetically ordered solids.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optical excitation with frequency comb can be used as a powerful tool for the control of magnetization dynamics and spin-wave excitations.
the frequency comb is a very efficient tool to control magnetization dynamics and TMOKE in magnetoplasmonics.
the frequency comb can be utilized as a source for resonant optical excitatation in magnetoplasmonics.
